The '''''Extempus''''' was a [[Delta-class carrier|''Delta''-class carrier]] that served in the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] as the [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]] of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Nezzor]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The ''Extempus'' participated in an [[Battle of Ruan|attack]] on the [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] [[Ruan]] in [[3640 BBY]], but was destroyed in a subsequent [[Battle of Duro (Galactic War)|attack]] on [[Duro/Legends|Duro]] when Nezzor was caught in an ambush.<ref name="Annihilation" />

==Description==
Moff Nezzors ''Extempus'' was a ''Delta''-class carrier that carried a complement of two dozen<ref name="Annihilation" /> [[Fury-class Imperial interceptor|''Fury''-class Imperial interceptors]]<ref name="Interceptor" />. It was also equipped with a [[Black cipher]] encryption device, meaning that the ship had to be among the largest capital ships in the Imperial Navy.<ref name="Annihilation" />
